# Jose Roberto Blanco Pulido

> Junior Software Developer | Web, Mobile and Desktop | JavaScript, Python, C#. Recent Virtual Environments and Digital Business engineering graduate with 2+ years of experience building web, mobile and desktop software. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C# and Kotlin, integrate services through REST APIs, and build tools and automations that remove repetitive work. I was lead developer of an Android app delivered end to end and built a web analytics system connected through a REST API. I adapt quickly to new languages, teams and domains, and I am looking for a junior developer position at an IT company. I am looking for a junior developer position at an IT company. Also available for freelance projects and collaborations. Location: Veracruz, Mexico. Contact: elroberuwu@gmail.com.

## Projects

- [Dual Analytics Dashboard](https://cloverfe.github.io/JoseRobertoBlanco.github.io/en/#dash): Restaurant analytics system: a Godot client sends data through a REST API to a web dashboard showing preparation and delivery times, hourly revenue, cancellations and peak hours. Stack: REST API, web development, data analytics, Godot.
- [CultivAR](https://cloverfe.github.io/JoseRobertoBlanco.github.io/en/#cultivar): Augmented reality that assists with tomato plant care: it detects the plant and shows care information in context on screen. Stack: C#, Unity, ARCore, Android.
- [Virtual Physics Lab](https://cloverfe.github.io/JoseRobertoBlanco.github.io/en/#vpl): A virtual lab where formulas become interactive experiments: students learn physics hands-on with extended reality headsets. Stack: C#, Unity, OpenXR.
- [Artizan Legacy](https://cloverfe.github.io/JoseRobertoBlanco.github.io/en/#legacy): Virtual reality app to talk with historical figures and explore their surroundings and their work. Exhibited at Universidad Tecnológica del Centro de Veracruz (UTCV) in 2024. Stack: C#, Unity, virtual reality (VR).
